csv_project_name: DEV for Recreational Vehicle & Trailer Storage Facility
csv_scope_of_work: The City is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced developers capable of planning, financing, constructing, and operating a new recreational vehicle, boat, and trailer storage facility on City owned land. The selected Respondent will enter into a long term ground lease and will be responsible for delivering a fully functional storage operation that meets all City standards and regulatory requirements.
